body.message:
Since the beginning, I made it clear that I wanted to stay in the apartment I had personally visited. However, I ended up paying for a different apartment that I had never seen before.

I checked our previous conversation, and I was never sent any photos or videos of this apartment before making the payment. Therefore, I could not have known about or agreed to the current setup, including the lack of privacy curtains.

I don’t feel comfortable being told that I accepted a “complete concept” when I was never given the opportunity to see or approve this apartment beforehand. I would really appreciate a fair solution, especially regarding the privacy issue.
